  Analysis code for the manuscript on sensory impairment, frailty, and incident
  dementia in the HRS (United States) and ELSA (England) cohorts.

  DATA NOT INCLUDED. HRS and ELSA are restricted-access and cannot be
  redistributed. Obtain the source data from the data providers and place them
  under data/ (git-ignored) so the relative paths in this notebook resolve.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

```




```{r}
# ============================================================================
# FIGURE 1 — 3 x 2 composite: HR forest plots (left) + PAF lollipops (right)
# Rows: Hearing / Vision / Frailty
# ============================================================================

# ---- 1. Hazard ratio data --------------------------------------------------
res <- tibble::tribble(
  ~exposure,  ~model, ~cohort, ~HR,   ~lcl,  ~ucl,
  # Hearing
  "Hearing",  "M1",   "HRS",   1.88,  1.75,  2.01,
  "Hearing",  "M1",   "ELSA",  1.93,  1.63,  2.28,
  "Hearing",  "M2",   "HRS",   1.34,  1.25,  1.44,
  "Hearing",  "M2",   "ELSA",  1.24,  1.04,  1.47,
  "Hearing",  "M3",   "HRS",   1.17,  1.09,  1.26,
  "Hearing",  "M3",   "ELSA",  1.20,  1.01,  1.43,
  "Hearing",  "M4",   "HRS",   1.10,  1.02,  1.18,
  "Hearing",  "M4",   "ELSA",  1.08,  0.91,  1.28,
  # Vision
  "Vision",   "M1",   "HRS",   2.15,  2.01,  2.31,
  "Vision",   "M1",   "ELSA",  3.13,  2.63,  3.71,
  "Vision",   "M2",   "HRS",   1.88,  1.75,  2.01,
  "Vision",   "M2",   "ELSA",  1.87,  1.56,  2.25,
  "Vision",   "M3",   "HRS",   1.32,  1.23,  1.42,
  "Vision",   "M3",   "ELSA",  1.80,  1.50,  2.16,
  "Vision",   "M4",   "HRS",   1.21,  1.13,  1.30,
  "Vision",   "M4",   "ELSA",  1.56,  1.30,  1.88,
  # Frailty
  "Frailty",  "M1",   "HRS",   2.70,  2.53,  2.88,
  "Frailty",  "M1",   "ELSA",  4.02,  3.40,  4.76,
  "Frailty",  "M2",   "HRS",   2.02,  1.89,  2.17,
  "Frailty",  "M2",   "ELSA",  2.41,  2.01,  2.90,
  "Frailty",  "M3",   "HRS",   1.50,  1.40,  1.61,
  "Frailty",  "M3",   "ELSA",  2.29,  1.91,  2.76,
  "Frailty",  "M4",   "HRS",   1.43,  1.33,  1.54,
  "Frailty",  "M4",   "ELSA",  2.10,  1.74,  2.53
)

# ---- 2. PAF data -----------------------------------------------------------
paf <- tribble(
  ~cohort, ~exposure,  ~model, ~prev,   ~paf,  ~lo,   ~hi,
  # HRS
  "HRS",   "Hearing",  1, 0.2050, 15.2, 13.3, 17.2,
  "HRS",   "Hearing",  2, 0.2050,  6.5,  4.7,  8.3,
  "HRS",   "Hearing",  3, 0.2050,  3.4,  1.8,  5.1,
  "HRS",   "Hearing",  4, 0.2050,  1.9,  0.3,  3.6,
  "HRS",   "Vision",   1, 0.2220, 20.4, 18.3, 22.4,
  "HRS",   "Vision",   2, 0.2220, 16.2, 14.2, 18.3,
  "HRS",   "Vision",   3, 0.2220,  6.7,  4.9,  8.5,
  "HRS",   "Vision",   4, 0.2220,  4.5,  2.8,  6.3,
  "HRS",   "Frailty",  1, 0.2900, 33.0, 30.7, 35.3,
  "HRS",   "Frailty",  2, 0.2900, 22.9, 20.4, 25.4,
  "HRS",   "Frailty",  3, 0.2900, 12.7, 10.4, 15.1,
  "HRS",   "Frailty",  4, 0.2900, 11.1,  8.7, 13.4,
  # ELSA
  "ELSA",  "Hearing",  1, 0.2053, 16.0, 11.4, 20.9,
  "ELSA",  "Hearing",  2, 0.2053,  4.6,  0.8,  8.8,
  "ELSA",  "Hearing",  3, 0.2053,  4.0,  0.2,  8.0,
  "ELSA",  "Hearing",  4, 0.2053,  1.5, -2.1,  5.4,
  "ELSA",  "Vision",   1, 0.1267, 21.2, 17.1, 25.5,
  "ELSA",  "Vision",   2, 0.1267,  9.9,  6.6, 13.7,
  "ELSA",  "Vision",   3, 0.1267,  9.2,  6.0, 12.8,
  "ELSA",  "Vision",   4, 0.1267,  6.6,  3.6, 10.0,
  "ELSA",  "Frailty",  1, 0.1264, 27.7, 23.3, 32.2,
  "ELSA",  "Frailty",  2, 0.1264, 15.2, 11.3, 19.4,
  "ELSA",  "Frailty",  3, 0.1264, 14.1, 10.4, 18.3,
  "ELSA",  "Frailty",  4, 0.1264, 12.2,  8.5, 16.2
)

# ---- 3. Shared factor levels & colours -------------------------------------
model_levels <- c("M4", "M3", "M2", "M1")        # M1 on top

# Sensory-impairment exposures (Hearing & Vision): M4 additionally adjusts
# for frailty status.
model_labels_sensory <- c(
  M1 = "Model 1\nUnadjusted",
  M2 = "Model 2\n+ chronological age",
  M3 = "Model 3\n+ sociodemographic\nfactors",
  M4 = "Model 4\n+ frailty status"
)

# Frailty exposure: M4 additionally adjusts for sensory impairments.
model_labels_frailty <- c(
  M1 = "Model 1\nUnadjusted",
  M2 = "Model 2\n+ chronological age",
  M3 = "Model 3\n+ sociodemographic\nfactors",
  M4 = "Model 4\n+ sensory impairments"
)

# Okabe-Ito colourblind-safe palette
pal <- c(HRS = "#0072B2", ELSA = "#D55E00")

res <- res %>%
  mutate(
    model    = factor(model, levels = model_levels),
    cohort   = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
    exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision", "Frailty")),
    label    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", HR, lcl, ucl),
    y_num    = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18)
  )

paf <- paf %>%
  mutate(
    model    = factor(paste0("M", model), levels = model_levels),
    cohort   = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
    exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision", "Frailty")),
    paf_lab  = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", paf, lo, hi),
    y_num    = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18)
  )

# ---- 4. Unified axis ranges (linear HR scale; tighter right expansion) ----
hr_xlim     <- c(0.8, 5.0)
hr_breaks   <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
hr_label_x  <- 5.10                  # was 5.25 — closer to axis end
paf_xlim    <- c(-3, 50)
paf_breaks  <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35)
paf_label_x <- 36

# ---- 5. Panel builders -----------------------------------------------------
make_hr_panel <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                          show_title   = TRUE,
                          show_x_title = FALSE,
                          show_y_text  = TRUE,
                          y_labels     = model_labels_sensory) {

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = HR, y = y_num, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lcl, xmax = ucl),
                   height = 0, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = hr_label_x, label = label),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = hr_breaks,
      limits = hr_xlim,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.55)),  # was 0.85 — stretches axis
      oob    = scales::oob_keep
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(model_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) y_labels[model_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(model_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 2.0)
    )) +
    labs(
      title = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      x     = if (show_x_title) "Hazard ratio for incident dementia" else NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "top",
      legend.justification = "right",
      legend.text          = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.width     = unit(10, "pt"),
      legend.key.height    = unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 12, 4, 4)
    )
}

make_paf_panel <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                           show_title   = TRUE,
                           show_x_title = FALSE,
                           show_y_text  = FALSE,
                           y_labels     = model_labels_sensory) {

  prev_txt <- dat %>%
    distinct(cohort, prev) %>%
    mutate(txt = sprintf("%s %.1f%%", cohort, 100 * prev)) %>%
    summarise(subtitle = paste0("Person-time prevalence: ",
                                paste(txt, collapse = "  \u00b7  "))) %>%
    pull(subtitle)

  ggplot(dat, aes(y = y_num, x = paf, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = paf, yend = y_num),
                 linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7) +
    geom_text(aes(x = paf_label_x, label = paf_lab),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = paf_breaks,
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      limits = paf_xlim,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(model_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) y_labels[model_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(model_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      subtitle = prev_txt,
      x        = if (show_x_title) "Population attributable fraction for incident dementia (%)" else NULL,
      y        = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 1)),
      plot.subtitle        = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey25",
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "none",
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# ---- 6. Build six panels ---------------------------------------------------
# X-axis ticks/labels on every panel; X-axis title only on the bottom row.
# Right-column (PAF) panels have no panel title.
# Hearing & Vision get model_labels_sensory (M4 = "+ frailty status").
# Frailty gets model_labels_frailty (M4 = "+ sensory impairments").
pA <- make_hr_panel(filter(res, exposure == "Hearing"),
                    "a", "Hearing impairment",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_sensory)
pB <- make_hr_panel(filter(res, exposure == "Vision"),
                    "b", "Vision impairment",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_sensory)
pC <- make_hr_panel(filter(res, exposure == "Frailty"),
                    "c", "Frailty",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    show_x_title = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_frailty)

pD <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf, exposure == "Hearing"),
                     "", "", show_title = FALSE)
pE <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf, exposure == "Vision"),
                     "", "", show_title = FALSE)
pF <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf, exposure == "Frailty"),
                     "", "", show_title = FALSE,
                     show_x_title = TRUE)

# ---- 7. Compose 3 x 2 layout ----------------------------------------------
fig <- (pA | pD) /
       (pB | pE) /
       (pC | pF) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1), widths = c(1, 1.05),
              guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position      = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box.margin    = margin(b = -2))

fig

# ---- 8. Save (Nature double-column spec) -----------------------------------
out_dir <- "output"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure_combined_HR_PAF_HRS_vs_ELSA_nature.png"),
       fig, width = 183, height = 215, units = "mm",
       dpi = 600, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure_combined_HR_PAF_HRS_vs_ELSA_nature.pdf"),
       fig, width = 183, height = 215, units = "mm",
       device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")

```




```{r table4-context-paf}
# ============================================================================
# FIGURE 2 — Table 4: Context-specific sensory impairment (fully adjusted)
# 2 x 2 composite: HR forest (left) + PAF lollipop (right); rows = Hearing/Vision
# ============================================================================

# ---- 1. Table 4 hazard ratios ---------------------------------------------
hr_t4 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~exposure, ~pathway,    ~cohort, ~N,     ~HR,  ~lcl, ~ucl,
  # Hearing
  "Hearing", "Before",    "HRS",   5132,   0.88, 0.78, 0.99,
  "Hearing", "With/subsequent to","HRS",   4859,   1.31, 1.21, 1.43,
  "Hearing", "Before",    "ELSA",  4130,   0.91, 0.73, 1.13,
  "Hearing", "With/subsequent to","ELSA",  1514,   1.70, 1.37, 2.10,
  # Vision
  "Vision",  "Before",    "HRS",   5824,   1.03, 0.91, 1.15,
  "Vision",  "With/subsequent to","HRS",   6115,   1.44, 1.33, 1.55,
  "Vision",  "Before",    "ELSA",  3118,   1.22, 0.95, 1.57,
  "Vision",  "With/subsequent to","ELSA",  1762,   2.28, 1.84, 2.82
)

# ---- 2. Table 4 PAFs (including total context-PAF) -------------------------
paf_t4 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~exposure, ~pathway,    ~cohort, ~paf, ~lo,  ~hi,
  # Hearing
  "Hearing", "Before",    "HRS",   -1.1, -2.1, -0.1,
  "Hearing", "With/subsequent to","HRS",    3.4,  2.3,  4.6,
  "Hearing", "Total",     "HRS",    2.3,  0.7,  4.0,
  "Hearing", "Before",    "ELSA",  -1.3, -3.9,  1.7,
  "Hearing", "With/subsequent to","ELSA",   4.2,  2.3,  6.5,
  "Hearing", "Total",     "ELSA",   2.9, -0.6,  6.9,
  # Vision
  "Vision",  "Before",    "HRS",    0.2, -0.7,  1.3,
  "Vision",  "With/subsequent to","HRS",    5.5,  4.3,  6.9,
  "Vision",  "Total",     "HRS",    5.8,  4.0,  7.6,
  "Vision",  "Before",    "ELSA",   1.5, -0.4,  3.8,
  "Vision",  "With/subsequent to","ELSA",   6.4,  4.3,  8.8,
  "Vision",  "Total",     "ELSA",   7.9,  4.9, 11.3
)

# ---- 3. Shared factor levels and cohort palette ----------------------------
pathway_levels <- c("Total", "With/subsequent to", "Before")
pathway_labels <- c(
  "Before"             = "Before frailty onset",
  "With/subsequent to" = "With or subsequent to frailty onset",
  "Total"              = "Total context"
)
pal <- c(HRS = "#0072B2", ELSA = "#D55E00")

hr_t4 <- hr_t4 %>%
  mutate(
    pathway  = factor(pathway,  levels = pathway_levels),
    cohort   = factor(cohort,   levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
    exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision")),
    label    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", HR, lcl, ucl),
    y_num    = as.numeric(pathway) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18)
  )

paf_t4 <- paf_t4 %>%
  mutate(
    pathway  = factor(pathway,  levels = pathway_levels),
    cohort   = factor(cohort,   levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
    exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision")),
    paf_lab  = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", paf, lo, hi),
    y_num    = as.numeric(pathway) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18)
  )

# ---- 4. Unified axis ranges (linear HR scale) ------------------------------
hr_xlim_t4    <- c(0.65, 3.0)
hr_breaks_t4  <- c(1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3)
hr_label_x4   <- 3.15
paf_xlim_t4   <- c(-6, 18)
paf_breaks_t4 <- c(-2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
paf_label_x4  <- 10.5

# ---- 5. Panel builders ----------------------------------------------------
make_hr_panel_t4 <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                             show_title   = TRUE,
                             show_x_title = FALSE,
                             show_y_text  = TRUE) {

  # Blank placeholder at the "Total" y position so the HR panel aligns
  # vertically with the PAF panel (which has a Total row).
  blank_total <- dat %>% distinct(cohort) %>%
    mutate(pathway = factor("Total", levels = pathway_levels),
           y_num   = as.numeric(pathway) +
                     ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = HR, y = y_num, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lcl, xmax = ucl),
                   height = 0, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6) +
    geom_text(aes(x = hr_label_x4, label = label),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_blank(data = blank_total, aes(x = 1, y = y_num, colour = cohort)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = hr_breaks_t4,
      limits = hr_xlim_t4,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.65)),
      oob    = scales::oob_keep
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(pathway_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) pathway_labels[pathway_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(pathway_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 2.0)
    )) +
    labs(
      title = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      x     = if (show_x_title) "Hazard ratio for incident dementia" else NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "top",
      legend.justification = "right",
      legend.text          = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.width     = unit(10, "pt"),
      legend.key.height    = unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 12, 4, 4)
    )
}

make_paf_panel_t4 <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                              show_title   = TRUE,
                              show_x_title = FALSE,
                              show_y_text  = FALSE) {

  ggplot(dat, aes(y = y_num, x = paf, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = paf, yend = y_num),
                 linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = pathway == "Total"), size = 1.9) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
    geom_text(aes(x = paf_label_x4, label = paf_lab),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = paf_breaks_t4,
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      limits = paf_xlim_t4,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(pathway_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) pathway_labels[pathway_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(pathway_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      x     = if (show_x_title) "Population attributable fraction for incident dementia (%)" else NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "none",
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# ---- 6. Build four panels --------------------------------------------------
# Letters renumbered: HR panels are a (Hearing) and b (Vision);
# the right-column PAF panels carry no title.
qA <- make_hr_panel_t4(filter(hr_t4,  exposure == "Hearing"),
                       "a", "Hearing impairment",
                       show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE)
qB <- make_paf_panel_t4(filter(paf_t4, exposure == "Hearing"),
                        "", "", show_title = FALSE)
qC <- make_hr_panel_t4(filter(hr_t4,  exposure == "Vision"),
                       "b", "Vision impairment",
                       show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                       show_x_title = TRUE)
qD <- make_paf_panel_t4(filter(paf_t4, exposure == "Vision"),
                        "", "", show_title = FALSE,
                        show_x_title = TRUE)

# ---- 7. Compose 2 x 2 layout ----------------------------------------------
fig_t4 <- (qA | qB) /
          (qC | qD) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1), widths = c(1, 1.05),
              guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position      = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box.margin    = margin(b = -2))

fig_t4

# ---- 8. Save (Nature double-column spec) ----------------------------------
out_dir <- "output"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure_Table4_context_HR_PAF.png"),
       fig_t4, width = 183, height = 140, units = "mm",
       dpi = 600, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Figure_Table4_context_HR_PAF.pdf"),
       fig_t4, width = 183, height = 140, units = "mm",
       device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
library(forestploter); library(grid); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(purrr);       library(tibble); library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. Load + sanity check ----------------------------------------------
sub_HRS  <- readRDS("results/subgroup_HRS.rds")
sub_ELSA <- readRDS("results/subgroup_ELSA.rds")

# Compatibility shim: older saves were flat (m4_h, m4_v, ...), newer ones
# wrap them in $cox plus $paf and $forest.
get_cox <- function(x) if (!is.null(x$cox)) x$cox else x
get_paf <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x$paf)) return(x$paf)
  stop("PAF data not found in this RDS. Re-save it as a list with ",
       "$cox / $paf / $forest slots (see the PAF + forest block).")
}
cox_HRS  <- get_cox(sub_HRS);   paf_HRS  <- get_paf(sub_HRS)
cox_ELSA <- get_cox(sub_ELSA);  paf_ELSA <- get_paf(sub_ELSA)

stopifnot(!identical(cox_HRS, cox_ELSA))
cat("HRS m4_h n_int[1] =", cox_HRS$m4_h$n_int[1],
    "  ELSA m4_h n_int[1] =", cox_ELSA$m4_h$n_int[1], "\n")

# ---- 2. HR pipeline: split M5 + merge cohorts ----------------------------
split_m5 <- function(res) list(
  nf = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                         HR = HR_1, lo = lo_1, hi = hi_1, p_int),
  fr = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                         HR = HR_2, lo = lo_2, hi = hi_2, p_int)
)
HRS_m5h  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_h);  HRS_m5v  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_v)
ELSA_m5h <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_h); ELSA_m5v <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_v)

merge_cohorts <- function(res_HRS, res_ELSA) {
  full_join(
    res_HRS  %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_HRS = HR, lo_HRS = lo, hi_HRS = hi,
                           p_HRS  = p_int),
    res_ELSA %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_ELSA = HR, lo_ELSA = lo, hi_ELSA = hi,
                           p_ELSA  = p_int),
    by = c("group","stratum")
  )
}
sec <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_h, cox_ELSA$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_v, cox_ELSA$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_f, cox_ELSA$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5h$nf,   ELSA_m5h$nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5h$fr,   ELSA_m5h$fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5v$nf,   ELSA_m5v$nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5v$fr,   ELSA_m5v$fr)
)

# ---- 2b. PAF pipeline: extract per-section PAFs + merge cohorts ----------
# Borrow p_int from the matching HR section so the PAF plot can show the
# same interaction p-values.
extract_paf <- function(paf, model_id, exposure_label) {
  paf %>%
    filter(model == model_id, exposure == exposure_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, stratum, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}
merge_paf <- function(p_HRS_tab, p_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label, sec_entry) {
  hrs <- extract_paf(p_HRS_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_HRS = 100 * PAF,
              lo_HRS  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_HRS  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  elsa <- extract_paf(p_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_ELSA = 100 * PAF,
              lo_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  pints <- sec_entry %>% transmute(group, stratum, p_HRS, p_ELSA)
  hrs %>%
    full_join(elsa,  by = c("group", "stratum")) %>%
    left_join(pints, by = c("group", "stratum"))
}

# PAF table uses the original long factor labels ("Hearing loss, ...").
sec_paf <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Hearing loss",                   sec$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Vision loss",                    sec$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Frailty",                        sec$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, no frailty yet",   sec$m5_h_nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, frailty present",  sec$m5_h_fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, no frailty yet",    sec$m5_v_nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, frailty present",   sec$m5_v_fr)
)

# ---- 3. Formatters --------------------------------------------------------
fmt_hr  <- function(x, l, u)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", x, l, u))
fmt_paf <- function(x, l, u)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", x, l, u))
fmt_p   <- function(p)
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < .001, "<.001",
                sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.2f", p))))

# ---- 4. Section-chunk builders (HR and PAF) ------------------------------
build_section_chunk <- function(res, section_title,
                                est_HRS, lo_HRS_v, hi_HRS_v,
                                est_ELSA, lo_ELSA_v, hi_ELSA_v,
                                fmt_fn) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Subgroup = section_title,
           est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
           est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
           hrs_txt = "", elsa_txt = "",
           p_hrs = "", p_elsa = "",
           row_type = "section"),
    res %>% group_split(group) %>% map_dfr(function(df) {
      # Pull values out FIRST so tibble's data masking can't redefine
      # est_HRS/lo_HRS_v/... as the newly-created columns.
      vH  <- df[[est_HRS]];   vlH <- df[[lo_HRS_v]];   vhH <- df[[hi_HRS_v]]
      vE  <- df[[est_ELSA]];  vlE <- df[[lo_ELSA_v]];  vhE <- df[[hi_ELSA_v]]
      bind_rows(
        tibble(Subgroup = df$group[1],
               est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
               est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
               hrs_txt = "", elsa_txt = "",
               p_hrs  = fmt_p(df$p_HRS[1]),
               p_elsa = fmt_p(df$p_ELSA[1]),
               row_type = "group"),
        tibble(
          Subgroup = paste0("   ", as.character(df$stratum)),
          est_HRS  = vH,   lo_HRS  = vlH,  hi_HRS  = vhH,
          est_ELSA = vE,   lo_ELSA = vlE,  hi_ELSA = vhE,
          hrs_txt  = fmt_fn(vH, vlH, vhH),
          elsa_txt = fmt_fn(vE, vlE, vhE),
          p_hrs = "", p_elsa = "",
          row_type = "stratum"
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

section_titles <- c(
  m4_h    = "Model 4: Hearing impairment",
  m4_v    = "Model 4: Vision impairment",
  m4_f    = "Model 4: Frailty (mutually adjusted)",
  m5_h_nf = "Model 5: Hearing impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_h_fr = "Model 5: Hearing impairment with or after frailty onset",
  m5_v_nf = "Model 5: Vision impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_v_fr = "Model 5: Vision impairment with or after frailty onset"
)

combined_hr <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec, section_titles[names(sec)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "HR_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "HR_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        fmt_hr)
))
combined_paf <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec_paf, section_titles[names(sec_paf)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "PAF_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "PAF_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        fmt_paf)
))

# ---- 5. Theme ------------------------------------------------------------
HRS_COLOR  <- "#0072B2"   # navy blue
ELSA_COLOR <- "#D55E00"   # vermillion

nc_theme <- forest_theme(
  base_size        = 8.5,
  base_family      = "sans",
  refline_gp       = gpar(col = "grey45", lty = "dotted", lwd = 0.6),
  ci_pch           = c(15, 16),
  ci_col           = c(HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_fill          = c(HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_lwd           = 0.9,
  ci_Theight       = 0,
  xaxis_gp         = gpar(cex = 0.72, lwd = 0.55),
  colhead          = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", cex = 0.80)),
  core             = list(bg_params = list(fill = "white", col = NA)),
  arrow_type       = "open",
  arrow_label_just = "end",
  legend_name      = "Cohort",
  legend_value     = c("HRS", "ELSA"),
  legend_position  = "bottom"
)

# ---- 6. Forest builders --------------------------------------------------
# Column order (same for HR and PAF):
#   1 Subgroup | 2 est HRS | 3 [HRS panel] | 4 P int | 5 est ELSA | 6 [ELSA panel] | 7 P int
make_forest <- function(pdf,
                        est_label,     # column header for estimate text
                        ref_line,
                        x_breaks,
                        x_trans   = "none",
                        arrow_lab) {
  blank <- paste(rep(" ", 22), collapse = " ")
  d <- tibble(
    `Subgroup`          = pdf$Subgroup,
    !!est_label         := pdf$hrs_txt,
    `HRS`               = blank,
    `P interaction`     = pdf$p_hrs,
    !!paste0(est_label, " ") := pdf$elsa_txt,
    `ELSA`              = blank,
    `P interaction `    = pdf$p_elsa
  )

  p <- forest(
    data       = d,
    est        = list(pdf$est_HRS, pdf$est_ELSA),
    lower      = list(pdf$lo_HRS,  pdf$lo_ELSA),
    upper      = list(pdf$hi_HRS,  pdf$hi_ELSA),
    sizes      = 0.45,
    ci_column  = c(3, 6),
    ref_line   = ref_line,
    arrow_lab  = arrow_lab,
    xlim       = c(min(x_breaks), max(x_breaks)),
    ticks_at   = x_breaks,
    x_trans    = x_trans,
    theme      = nc_theme
  )

  sec_rows <- which(pdf$row_type == "section")
  for (r in sec_rows)
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 8.8))
  for (r in which(pdf$row_type == "group"))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  for (r in sec_rows[-1])
    p <- add_border(p, row = r, part = "body", where = "top",
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.4, col = "grey70"))

  stratum_rows <- which(pdf$row_type == "stratum")
  for (r in stratum_rows) {
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 3, which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 6, which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
  }
  p
}

# HR forest (log scale, ref = 1)
p_hr <- make_forest(
  combined_hr,
  est_label = "HR (95% CI)",
  ref_line  = 1,
  x_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
  x_trans   = "log",
  arrow_lab = c("Lower risk", "Higher risk")
)

# PAF forest (linear scale in %, ref = 0).
# Pick breaks from observed range, padded to nice integers.
paf_rng    <- range(c(combined_paf$lo_HRS, combined_paf$hi_HRS,
                      combined_paf$lo_ELSA, combined_paf$hi_ELSA),
                    na.rm = TRUE, finite = TRUE)
paf_breaks <- pretty(c(min(0, paf_rng[1]), paf_rng[2]), n = 6)

p_paf <- make_forest(
  combined_paf,
  est_label = "PAF (95% CI)",
  ref_line  = 0,
  x_breaks  = paf_breaks,
  x_trans   = "none",
  arrow_lab = c("Protective", "Attributable")
)

# ---- 7. Save -------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
save_horizontal <- function(p, pdf, path, w = 12, row_h = 0.22, pad = 1.5) {
  h <- row_h * nrow(pdf) + pad
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".pdf"), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), p, width = w, height = h,
         units = "in", dpi = 600)
  message(sprintf("saved %s (%.1f x %.1f in)", basename(path), w, h))
}
save_horizontal(p_hr,  combined_hr,  "figures/forest_subgroup_hr_horizontal")
save_horizontal(p_paf, combined_paf, "figures/forest_subgroup_paf_horizontal")

print(p_hr)
print(p_paf)
```

```{r}
library(forestploter); library(grid); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(purrr);       library(tibble); library(ggplot2)
# Install once if missing — much sharper PNG anti-aliasing than the default device:
# install.packages("ragg")

# ---- 1. Load results and sanity-check cohorts ----------------------------
sub_HRS  <- readRDS("results/subgroup_HRS.rds")
sub_ELSA <- readRDS("results/subgroup_ELSA.rds")

get_cox <- function(x) if (!is.null(x$cox)) x$cox else x
get_paf <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x$paf)) return(x$paf)
  stop("Population attributable fraction data not found in this RDS. ",
       "Re-save it as a list with $cox / $paf / $forest slots ",
       "(see the PAF + forest block).")
}
cox_HRS  <- get_cox(sub_HRS);   paf_HRS  <- get_paf(sub_HRS)
cox_ELSA <- get_cox(sub_ELSA);  paf_ELSA <- get_paf(sub_ELSA)

stopifnot(!identical(cox_HRS, cox_ELSA))
cat("HRS  m4_h n_interaction[1] =", cox_HRS$m4_h$n_int[1],
    "   ELSA m4_h n_interaction[1] =", cox_ELSA$m4_h$n_int[1], "\n")

# ---- 2. Hazard-ratio pipeline: split Model 5 and merge cohorts -----------
split_m5 <- function(res) list(
  no_frailty       = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                       HR = HR_1, lo = lo_1, hi = hi_1, p_int),
  frailty_present  = res %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                       HR = HR_2, lo = lo_2, hi = hi_2, p_int)
)
HRS_m5_hearing  <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_h)
HRS_m5_vision   <- split_m5(cox_HRS$m5_v)
ELSA_m5_hearing <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_h)
ELSA_m5_vision  <- split_m5(cox_ELSA$m5_v)

merge_cohorts <- function(res_HRS, res_ELSA) {
  full_join(
    res_HRS  %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_HRS = HR, lo_HRS = lo, hi_HRS = hi,
                           p_interaction_HRS  = p_int),
    res_ELSA %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                           HR_ELSA = HR, lo_ELSA = lo, hi_ELSA = hi,
                           p_interaction_ELSA = p_int),
    by = c("group", "stratum")
  )
}
sec <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_h, cox_ELSA$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_v, cox_ELSA$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_cohorts(cox_HRS$m4_f, cox_ELSA$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_hearing$no_frailty,      ELSA_m5_hearing$no_frailty),
  m5_h_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_hearing$frailty_present, ELSA_m5_hearing$frailty_present),
  m5_v_nf = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_vision$no_frailty,       ELSA_m5_vision$no_frailty),
  m5_v_fr = merge_cohorts(HRS_m5_vision$frailty_present,  ELSA_m5_vision$frailty_present)
)

# ---- 2b. Population attributable fraction pipeline -----------------------
extract_paf <- function(paf, model_id, exposure_label) {
  paf %>%
    filter(model == model_id, exposure == exposure_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, stratum, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}
merge_paf <- function(paf_HRS_tab, paf_ELSA_tab,
                     model_id, exposure_label, sec_entry) {
  hrs <- extract_paf(paf_HRS_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_HRS = 100 * PAF,
              lo_HRS  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_HRS  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  elsa <- extract_paf(paf_ELSA_tab, model_id, exposure_label) %>%
    transmute(group, stratum,
              PAF_ELSA = 100 * PAF,
              lo_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_lcl,
              hi_ELSA  = 100 * PAF_ucl)
  pints <- sec_entry %>% transmute(group, stratum,
                                   p_interaction_HRS, p_interaction_ELSA)
  hrs %>%
    full_join(elsa,  by = c("group", "stratum")) %>%
    left_join(pints, by = c("group", "stratum"))
}

sec_paf <- list(
  m4_h    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Hearing loss",                   sec$m4_h),
  m4_v    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Vision loss",                    sec$m4_v),
  m4_f    = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M4",                   "Frailty",                        sec$m4_f),
  m5_h_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, no frailty yet",   sec$m5_h_nf),
  m5_h_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (hearing context)", "Hearing loss, frailty present",  sec$m5_h_fr),
  m5_v_nf = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, no frailty yet",    sec$m5_v_nf),
  m5_v_fr = merge_paf(paf_HRS, paf_ELSA, "M5 (vision context)",  "Vision loss, frailty present",   sec$m5_v_fr)
)

# ---- 3. Formatters --------------------------------------------------------
format_hazard_ratio <- function(estimate, lower, upper)
  ifelse(is.na(estimate), "\u2014",
         sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, lower, upper))

format_paf <- function(estimate, lower, upper)
  ifelse(is.na(estimate), "\u2014",
         sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", estimate, lower, upper))

format_p_value <- function(p)
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < .001, "<.001",
                sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.2f", p))))

# ---- 4. Section-chunk builder (shared by HR and PAF) --------------------
build_section_chunk <- function(res, section_title,
                                est_HRS, lo_HRS_v, hi_HRS_v,
                                est_ELSA, lo_ELSA_v, hi_ELSA_v,
                                format_fn) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Subgroup = section_title,
           est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
           est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
           hrs_text = "", elsa_text = "",
           p_interaction_hrs = "", p_interaction_elsa = "",
           row_type = "section"),
    res %>% group_split(group) %>% map_dfr(function(df) {
      vH  <- df[[est_HRS]];   vlH <- df[[lo_HRS_v]];   vhH <- df[[hi_HRS_v]]
      vE  <- df[[est_ELSA]];  vlE <- df[[lo_ELSA_v]];  vhE <- df[[hi_ELSA_v]]
      bind_rows(
        tibble(Subgroup = df$group[1],
               est_HRS = NA_real_,  lo_HRS = NA_real_,  hi_HRS = NA_real_,
               est_ELSA = NA_real_, lo_ELSA = NA_real_, hi_ELSA = NA_real_,
               hrs_text = "", elsa_text = "",
               p_interaction_hrs  = format_p_value(df$p_interaction_HRS[1]),
               p_interaction_elsa = format_p_value(df$p_interaction_ELSA[1]),
               row_type = "group"),
        tibble(
          Subgroup  = paste0("   ", as.character(df$stratum)),
          est_HRS   = vH,  lo_HRS  = vlH, hi_HRS  = vhH,
          est_ELSA  = vE,  lo_ELSA = vlE, hi_ELSA = vhE,
          hrs_text  = format_fn(vH, vlH, vhH),
          elsa_text = format_fn(vE, vlE, vhE),
          p_interaction_hrs = "", p_interaction_elsa = "",
          row_type  = "stratum"
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

# CHANGED: "with or after frailty onset" -> "with or subsequent to frailty onset"
section_titles <- c(
  m4_h    = "Model 4: Hearing impairment",
  m4_v    = "Model 4: Vision impairment",
  m4_f    = "Model 4: Frailty (mutually adjusted)",
  m5_h_nf = "Model 5: Hearing impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_h_fr = "Model 5: Hearing impairment with or subsequent to frailty onset",
  m5_v_nf = "Model 5: Vision impairment before frailty onset",
  m5_v_fr = "Model 5: Vision impairment with or subsequent to frailty onset"
)

combined_hr <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec, section_titles[names(sec)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "HR_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "HR_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        format_hazard_ratio)
))
combined_paf <- bind_rows(map2(
  sec_paf, section_titles[names(sec_paf)],
  ~ build_section_chunk(.x, .y,
                        "PAF_HRS",  "lo_HRS",  "hi_HRS",
                        "PAF_ELSA", "lo_ELSA", "hi_ELSA",
                        format_paf)
))

stopifnot(nrow(combined_hr) == nrow(combined_paf),
          identical(combined_hr$Subgroup, combined_paf$Subgroup),
          identical(combined_hr$row_type, combined_paf$row_type))

# ============================================================================
# 5. Theme — UPGRADED for print-quality clarity (was tuned for 8.5-pt column)
# ============================================================================
HRS_COLOR  <- "#0072B2"   # navy blue
ELSA_COLOR <- "#D55E00"   # vermillion

nc_theme <- forest_theme(
  base_size        = 10.5,                              # was 8.5
  base_family      = "sans",
  refline_gp       = gpar(col = "grey40", lty = "dotted", lwd = 0.9),  # was 0.6
  ci_pch           = c(15, 15, 16, 16),
  ci_col           = c(HRS_COLOR, HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_fill          = c(HRS_COLOR, HRS_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR, ELSA_COLOR),
  ci_lwd           = 1.4,                               # was 0.9
  ci_Theight       = 0,
  xaxis_gp         = gpar(cex = 0.90, lwd = 0.8, fontface = "plain"),  # was 0.72, 0.55
  colhead          = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", cex = 0.95)),  # was 0.80
  core             = list(bg_params = list(fill = "white", col = NA)),
  arrow_type       = "open",
  arrow_label_just = "end",
  legend_name      = "Cohort \u00B7 Estimand",
  legend_value     = c("HRS \u00B7 Hazard ratio",
                       "HRS \u00B7 Population attributable fraction",
                       "ELSA \u00B7 Hazard ratio",
                       "ELSA \u00B7 Population attributable fraction"),
  legend_position  = "bottom"
)

# ============================================================================
# 6. Combined forest builder — forest plot FIRST, then numeric values
#    (consistent with Figs 3-4: plot on the left, values to the right)
# ============================================================================
make_combined_forest <- function(pdf_hr, pdf_paf,
                                 hr_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
                                 paf_breaks) {

  # Wider blank string → CI panel columns get more horizontal real estate,
  # so HR / PAF distributions read more clearly.  Was 18 spaces.
  blank <- paste(rep(" ", 28), collapse = " ")

  # CHANGED: each plotting column now comes BEFORE its value column, so the
  # forest plot is drawn first and the numeric estimate sits to its right.
  # New column positions:
  #   1  Subgroup
  #   2  HRS  [Hazard ratio]   <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   3  Hazard ratio (95% CI)        <- values
  #   4  HRS  [PAF]            <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   5  PAF (95% CI)                 <- values
  #   6  P interaction (HRS)
  #   7  ELSA [Hazard ratio]   <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   8  Hazard ratio (95% CI)        <- values
  #   9  ELSA [PAF]            <- plot  (ci_column)
  #   10 PAF (95% CI)                 <- values
  #   11 P interaction (ELSA)
  d <- tibble(
    `Subgroup`                = pdf_hr$Subgroup,
    `HRS [Hazard ratio]`      = blank,
    `Hazard ratio (95% CI)`   = pdf_hr$hrs_text,
    `HRS [PAF]`               = blank,
    `PAF (95% CI)`            = pdf_paf$hrs_text,
    `P interaction (HRS)`     = pdf_hr$p_interaction_hrs,
    `ELSA [Hazard ratio]`     = blank,
    `Hazard ratio (95% CI) `  = pdf_hr$elsa_text,
    `ELSA [PAF]`              = blank,
    `PAF (95% CI) `           = pdf_paf$elsa_text,
    `P interaction (ELSA)`    = pdf_hr$p_interaction_elsa
  )

  p <- forest(
    data       = d,
    est        = list(pdf_hr$est_HRS,  pdf_paf$est_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$est_ELSA, pdf_paf$est_ELSA),
    lower      = list(pdf_hr$lo_HRS,   pdf_paf$lo_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$lo_ELSA,  pdf_paf$lo_ELSA),
    upper      = list(pdf_hr$hi_HRS,   pdf_paf$hi_HRS,
                      pdf_hr$hi_ELSA,  pdf_paf$hi_ELSA),
    sizes      = 0.60,                                  # was 0.45 — bigger markers
    ci_column  = c(2, 4, 7, 9),                         # CHANGED: was c(3, 5, 8, 10)
    ref_line   = c(1, 0, 1, 0),
    arrow_lab  = list(c("Lower risk",  "Higher risk"),
                      c("Protective",  "Attributable"),
                      c("Lower risk",  "Higher risk"),
                      c("Protective",  "Attributable")),
    xlim       = list(c(min(hr_breaks),  max(hr_breaks)),
                      c(min(paf_breaks), max(paf_breaks)),
                      c(min(hr_breaks),  max(hr_breaks)),
                      c(min(paf_breaks), max(paf_breaks))),
    ticks_at   = list(hr_breaks, paf_breaks, hr_breaks, paf_breaks),
    x_trans    = c("log", "none", "log", "none"),
    theme      = nc_theme
  )

  section_rows <- which(pdf_hr$row_type == "section")
  for (r in section_rows)
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 10.8))   # was 8.8
  for (r in which(pdf_hr$row_type == "group"))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, which = "text",
                   gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  for (r in section_rows[-1])
    p <- add_border(p, row = r, part = "body", where = "top",
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.6, col = "grey65"))           # was 0.4

  # CHANGED: CI-colour columns updated to the new plotting-column positions.
  stratum_rows <- which(pdf_hr$row_type == "stratum")
  for (r in stratum_rows) {
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 2,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 4,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = HRS_COLOR,  fill = HRS_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 7,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
    p <- edit_plot(p, row = r, col = 9,  which = "ci",
                   gp = gpar(col = ELSA_COLOR, fill = ELSA_COLOR))
  }

  p
}

paf_range  <- range(c(combined_paf$lo_HRS,  combined_paf$hi_HRS,
                      combined_paf$lo_ELSA, combined_paf$hi_ELSA),
                    na.rm = TRUE, finite = TRUE)
paf_breaks <- pretty(c(min(0, paf_range[1]), paf_range[2]), n = 6)

p_combined <- make_combined_forest(
  combined_hr, combined_paf,
  hr_breaks  = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
  paf_breaks = paf_breaks
)

# ============================================================================
# 7. Save — print-quality but not pathologically large
# ============================================================================
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

save_horizontal <- function(plot_obj, source_df, path,
                            width_in   = 18,     # Nature-friendly; was 20
                            row_height = 0.26,   # readable; was 0.34
                            padding    = 1.6,    # was 2.0
                            dpi_png    = 600) {  # print-quality without 4x blow-up

  height_in <- row_height * nrow(source_df) + padding

  # PDF — vector, always sharp, tiny file
  ggsave(paste0(path, ".pdf"), plot_obj,
         width = width_in, height = height_in,
         units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

  # PNG — ragg if available, else cairo
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), plot_obj,
           width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi = dpi_png, device = ragg::agg_png)
  } else {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".png"), plot_obj,
           width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi = dpi_png, type = "cairo")
  }

  # TIFF — only if the journal asks for it; otherwise comment out.
  # CHANGED: route through ggsave so the plot fills the canvas the same way
  # as the PNG (previous agg_tiff + print() rendered at intrinsic gtable size,
  # leaving a huge whitespace band and making the plot look low-res).
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(paste0(path, ".tiff"), plot_obj,
           width  = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in",
           dpi    = 600,
           device = ragg::agg_tiff,
           compression = "lzw")
  }

  message(sprintf("saved %s (%.1f x %.1f in, %d dpi PNG)",
                  basename(path), width_in, height_in, dpi_png))
}

save_horizontal(p_combined, combined_hr,
                "figures/forest_subgroup_HR_PAF_combined",
                width_in   = 24,    # was 18 — 11 columns need it
                row_height = 0.26,
                padding    = 1.8)

print(p_combined)
```

```{r}
# ---- 0. Shared palette ----------------------------------------------------
pal <- c(HRS = "#0072B2", ELSA = "#D55E00")

# ============================================================================
# 0a. Figure 1-style builders (M1–M4 panels)
# ============================================================================
make_hr_panel <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                          show_title   = TRUE,
                          show_x_title = FALSE,
                          show_y_text  = TRUE,
                          y_labels     = model_labels_sensory) {

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = HR, y = y_num, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lcl, xmax = ucl),
                   height = 0, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = hr_label_x, label = label),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = hr_breaks,
      limits = hr_xlim,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.55)),
      oob    = scales::oob_keep
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(model_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) y_labels[model_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(model_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 2.0)
    )) +
    labs(
      title = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      x     = if (show_x_title) "Hazard ratio for incident dementia" else NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "top",
      legend.justification = "right",
      legend.text          = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.width     = unit(10, "pt"),
      legend.key.height    = unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 12, 4, 4)
    )
}

make_paf_panel <- function(dat, panel_letter, exposure_label,
                           show_title   = TRUE,
                           show_x_title = FALSE,
                           show_y_text  = FALSE,
                           y_labels     = model_labels_sensory) {

  prev_txt <- dat %>%
    distinct(cohort, prev) %>%
    mutate(txt = sprintf("%s %.1f%%", cohort, 100 * prev)) %>%
    summarise(subtitle = paste0("Person-time prevalence: ",
                                paste(txt, collapse = "  \u00b7  "))) %>%
    pull(subtitle)

  ggplot(dat, aes(y = y_num, x = paf, colour = cohort)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = paf, yend = y_num),
                 linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1.7) +
    geom_text(aes(x = paf_label_x, label = paf_lab),
              colour = "black", fontface = "plain",
              hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = "Helvetica",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = paf_breaks,
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      limits = paf_xlim,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(model_levels),
      labels = if (show_y_text) y_labels[model_levels] else NULL,
      limits = c(0.4, length(model_levels) + 0.6),
      expand = expansion(add = 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = if (show_title) bquote(bold(.(panel_letter)) ~ ~ .(exposure_label)) else NULL,
      subtitle = prev_txt,
      x        = if (show_x_title) "Population attributable fraction for incident dementia (%)" else NULL,
      y        = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(face = "plain", size = 8,
                                          hjust = 0,
                                          margin = margin(b = 1)),
      plot.subtitle        = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey25",
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
      axis.line.x          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y          = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y         = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 6, colour = "black",
                                                           lineheight = 0.85)
                             else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      legend.position      = "none",
      plot.margin          = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ---- 3. Prep --------------------------------------------------------------
model_levels <- c("M4", "M3", "M2", "M1")
pal <- c(HRS = "#0072B2", ELSA = "#D55E00")
res_nadl <- res_nadl %>%
  mutate(model    = factor(model, levels = model_levels),
         cohort   = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
         exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision", "Frailty")),
         label    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", HR, lcl, ucl),
         y_num    = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18))
paf_nadl <- paf_nadl %>%
  mutate(model    = factor(paste0("M", model), levels = model_levels),
         cohort   = factor(cohort, levels = c("HRS", "ELSA")),
         exposure = factor(exposure, levels = c("Hearing", "Vision", "Frailty")),
         paf_lab  = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", paf, lo, hi),
         y_num    = as.numeric(model) + ifelse(cohort == "HRS", 0.18, -0.18))
# Max HR ~3.09: use a slightly tighter HR window than main Figure 1
hr_xlim     <- c(0.8, 4.0); hr_breaks <- c(1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5); hr_label_x  <- 4.05
paf_xlim    <- c(-3, 50);   paf_breaks <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35); paf_label_x <- 36
pA <- make_hr_panel(filter(res_nadl, exposure == "Hearing"),
                    "a", "Hearing impairment",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_sensory)
pB <- make_hr_panel(filter(res_nadl, exposure == "Vision"),
                    "b", "Vision impairment",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_sensory)
pC <- make_hr_panel(filter(res_nadl, exposure == "Frailty"),
                    "c", "Frailty",
                    show_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE,
                    show_x_title = TRUE,
                    y_labels   = model_labels_frailty)
pD <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf_nadl, exposure == "Hearing"), "", "", show_title = FALSE)
pE <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf_nadl, exposure == "Vision"),  "", "", show_title = FALSE)
pF <- make_paf_panel(filter(paf_nadl, exposure == "Frailty"), "", "", show_title = FALSE,
                     show_x_title = TRUE)
fig_S3a <- (pA | pD) / (pB | pE) / (pC | pF) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1), widths = c(1, 1.05), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box.margin = margin(b = -2))
```
